input.title: review: skip patchless PRs early
input.body: Skips PRs with no textual changes before fetching the rubric.

files.patch:
--- a/review.sh
+++ b/review.sh
@@ -1,2 +1,6 @@
 # changed files were collected as JSONL (one object per line):
 #   jq -c '.[]' <<<"$batch" >>"$files_jsonl"
+if ! jq -e 'any(.[]; .patch != null)' <"$files_jsonl" >/dev/null; then
+  echo "no textual changes to review (docs/binary-only?)"
+  exit 0
+fi

note: Isolated defect: without -s, jq reads each JSONL line as its own input; .[] iterates one object's values, .patch on a string errors, and 'if !' turns the error into skipping every PR.
